question: In sparcs_sample_records.csv, which facility_name has the highest total of total_costs across its records, considering only records with length_of_stay of at most 3 days? Answer with the facility name.
solve_py:
import os,pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
d=pd.read_csv(D+'/sparcs_sample_records.csv')
d=d[d.length_of_stay<=3]
print(d.groupby('facility_name').total_costs.sum().idxmax())
